full_frame.timing_policy: Synchronized wall time, warm filesystem/JIT, alternating order, allocation and transfers included. Full-frame totals include read, the named PTM backend, all descriptors/components, and NPZ compression. No production checksum scan, tracking or shared-filesystem writes included.

sequences.scope: Paired contiguous native 0.10-ps windows. Window-boundary censoring is shared; this is not a catalogue recount.

streaming.scope: Exact same contiguous frames and selective NPZ chunks; bounded stream versus sequential GPU extraction/compression. Includes reads, GPU work, compression, file writes and output hashing; excludes initial raw verification/startup.

cpu_pool.scope: Six simultaneous one-thread workers processing six adjacent real frames versus one GPU processing those same six frames serially. Both include warm reads, extraction and NPZ compression. Startup excluded; no output disk writes or tracking.

final_benchmark_cli.timing_policy: Synchronized wall time, warm filesystem/JIT, alternating order, allocation and transfers included. Full-frame totals include read, the named PTM backend, all descriptors/components, and NPZ compression. No production checksum scan, tracking or shared-filesystem writes included.

launch.purpose: Owned GPU PTM implementation and local correctness/throughput audit

scope: Local GPU implementation/performance/numerical audits. No production simulation, search job, cache or birth catalogue was changed. Different timing scopes are explicitly retained.
